explanation.headline: FDA's records show neostigmine methylsulfate is not on the current shortage list; a prior Fresenius Kabi discontinuation was posted 2026-01-12

sentences.text: As of 2026-10-21, neostigmine methylsulfate is not listed on FDA's drug shortage list.
FDA's shortage records show a prior posting for Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC marked "To Be Discontinued" with an initial posting date of 2026-01-12.
The product label we have on file names Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (FEI 2220525) as the registered manufacturing plant.
That plant's most recent FDA inspection (ID 1237333) ended 2024-06-12 and was classified VAI, with the classification known to FDA on 2024-12-16.
Corvale East holds 57 vials (0.5 mg/mL, 10 mL) with 15 days on hand at current use; Corvale General holds 109 vials with 28.1 days on hand.
The rule‑ranked first option is to buy from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today; its label names no plant we could place.
